changes_made.explanation: Added LibriSpeech 960h dataset which is explicitly mentioned in experiments. Normalized 'LibriSpeech' to 'LibriSpeech test-clean' for clarity.
Removed duplicate 'Speaker Similarity (SPK)' since SPK already represents speaker similarity metric. Kept all other metrics as normalized forms.
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The paper only mentions GPT in the context of in-context learning for speech generation, not for evaluation.
No human evaluations were conducted in this paper. All evaluations used automatic metrics (WER, SPK, DNSMOS, CER).

overall_notes: The paper focuses on speech generation using hierarchical transformers with semantic and acoustic tokens. Evaluation is entirely automatic with no human or LLM-based assessment. The extraction quality was generally good with minor duplicates that needed cleaning.
